items.title: England win series as Banton delivers on potential
items.description: Tom Banton delivers on all of his potential by crashing a brilliant first international century as England wrapped up their summer with an ODI series win over Sri Lanka.

items.title: Banton stars as England win Sri Lanka ODI series
items.description: Tom Banton delivers on all of his potential by crashing a brilliant first international century as England wrap up their summer with an ODI series win over Sri Lanka.

items.title: 'Brilliant' Banton scores maiden ODI century for England
items.description: Tom Banton scores a "brilliant" century, his first in an ODI for England, in the third and deciding game of the series against Sri Lanka at The Oval.

items.title: Superb South Africa seal series win over Australia
items.description: David Miller and Temba Bavuma's sublime centuries set up South Africa's 32-run win over Australia in a high-scoring second ODI in Johannesburg.

items.title: Kohli & Gill centuries help India past Windies - first ODI scorecard
items.description: Latest scorecard from the first one-day international between India and West Indies in Thiruvananthapuram.

items.title: Abell scores 307 in Somerset's draw with Surrey
items.description: Tom Abell scores a career-best 307 in Somerset's County Championship draw against Surrey at Taunton.

items.title: Durham draw with Lancashire to end season unbeaten
items.description: Durham end their title-winning campaign in County Championship Division Two unbeaten, finishing the season with a draw against Lancashire.

items.title: Test Match Special Podcast
items.description: England thrashed Sri Lanka at the Oval to finish the summer with a series victory.

items.title: Glamorgan & Essex draw as rain ruins final day
items.description: Glamorgan and Essex's final match is rained off after just 21 balls play on the fourth day.

items.title: The Bears' necessity: Just how good is top wicket-taker Bamber?
items.description: Does Ethan Bamber's fine form in Warwickshire's County Championship title triumph warrant closer scrutiny by England?

items.title: Warwickshire beat Leicestershire to seal ninth Championship title
items.description: Warwickshire complete their ninth County Championship title triumph with an innings victory against Leicestershire.

items.title: Mendis stars as Sri Lanka beat England to set up series decider
items.description: Kusal Mendis scores 121 to help Sri Lanka to a surprise win against England as they fought back to secure a 16-run victory against England at Headingley to level the three-match series and set up a decider at The Oval on Sunday.

items.title: 'He's changing the narrative' - Mendis' inspires Sri Lanka to victory
items.description: Kusal Mendis produces a captain's innings at Headingley as he scores 121 off 100 balls to put Sri Lanka on course for a big score as they bat first against England in the second One Day International.

items.title: England ease to big victory as Sri Lanka crumble in first ODI
items.description: England maintain their excellent one-day form in a comfortable victory against Sri Lanka, as Will Jacks' stars with bat and ball to help the home side to an 89-run win at Chester-le-Street in the first ODI.

items.title: Vital with the bat, crucial with the ball - Jacks stars in England win
items.description: Will Jacks produces a match-winning performance to help England to a comfortable 89-run victory over Sri Lanka at Chester-le-Street in the first one-day international of the three-match series.

items.title: Dream debut - Colombage takes three wickets to stifle England
items.description: Sachindu Colombage enjoys a debut to remember as he removes Joe Root, Jos Buttler and Jamie Overton to finish with figures of 3-44 in the first One Day International between England and Sri Lanka at Chester-le-Street.

items.title: Kent players 'deserve all credit' for promotion
items.description: Adam Hollioake praises his players for a "remarkable turnaround" as Kent secure Championship promotion, 12 months after finishing bottom of Division Two.

items.title: Bairstow six seals one-wicket win for Yorkshire
items.description: Captain Jonny Bairstow hits the winning runs as Yorkshire beat Nottinghamshire by one wicket in their final Championship match of the season.

items.title: Sussex end season with win at relegated Hampshire
items.description: Sussex beat Division One's bottom side Hampshire in their final County Championship fixture of 2026.

items.title: Kent celebrate promotion by beating Gloucestershire
items.description: Kent complete victory against Gloucestershire, with their promotion to Division One having already been confirmed by Northamptonshire's earlier defeat.

items.title: Allison stars as Worcs wrap up big win over Derbys
items.description: Ben Allison's first-class career-best of 6-42 in overall match figures of 11-64 helps Worcestershire to a comprehensive 175-run victory over Derbyshire.

items.title: Kent promoted as Middlesex beat Northants
items.description: Max Holden and Ben Geddes share a century partnership as Middlesex win to end Northamptonshire's faint chance of promotion.

items.title: Back and loving it - Pietersen on his history, Brook & helping win the Ashes
items.description: Former batter turned specialist mentor Kevin Pietersen talks about his new role with England, his past history with the ECB and working with Harry Brook and Brendon McCullum.

items.title: Pick your County Championship team of the season
items.description: Pick you best XI from the 2026 County Championship season. Who makes the cut?

items.title: New Lancashire CEO Kenyon to lead review of club
items.description: Incoming chief executive Richard Kenyon will lead a review of Lancashire's cricket operation and performance structure.

items.title: 'The lads wanted me to stick one up him' - Wood relives fastest spells
items.description: As England bowler Mark Wood retires from international cricket, he talks through his most famous spells from his Test career.

items.title: Debbie Beard and Amanda Thorpe lost their husbands - this is their story
items.description: Debbie Beard and Amanda Thorpe speak to the BBC's Simon Jack at the launch of a new suicide prevention toolkit.

items.title: Essex cricketer Das charged with two counts of rape
items.description: Essex cricketer Robin Das is charged with two counts of rape and will appear in court in October.

items.title: 'It was scary' - Jacks goes from emergency surgery to match-winner
items.description: Will Jacks' career-best 50-over figures on Tuesday came shortly after the England all-rounder was rushed into hospital for emergency surgery while on a weekend away.

items.title: Stumped
items.description: After a career blighted by injuries Mark Wood calls time on international career.
